bibl.title: Pestman in the Dock.
bibl.seg: Peter van Minnen, Pestman in the Dock.
bibl.note: English translation of a written report of the dissertation defense of P.W. Pestman on November 29, 1961. Discussion of the contemporary background of Pestman's dissertation on marriage in Ancient Egypt, including the so-called Lex Van Oven of 1956, which abolished the legal incapacity of married women in the Netherlands.
